caption:
Comment MOT for your free men's health MOT 🩺

Men rarely die young because of one big thing. Usually it's the appointment they kept putting off.

Movember's 2026 report for England says 36% of men die before 75, and men are 1.6 times as likely as women to die early.

Number 6 sounds silly. A 2022 study in the British Journal of Sports Medicine found adults aged 51 to 75 who couldn't stand on one leg for 10 seconds had a higher risk of dying over the next 7 years.

Which one have you been putting off?

Save this for the next time you say you're fine, and send it to the man in your life who hasn't seen a GP in years.
